resources.string: Reads the fare, distance and time on Rapido and Uber offer screens

RideScore reads the text of ride offers shown by Rapido Captain and Uber Driver so it can tell you what an offer is worth per hour and per kilometre.\n\nIt only reads. It never accepts, declines, taps, swipes or scrolls anything for you, and it never reads any other app. Nothing it reads leaves your phone.
Shown while the optional OCR fallback is switched on
Used only when offer text cannot be read directly
